changed.what: Acceptance and script step 1 called `frob spark check --list`, which NJL-01's action rule makes an 802 schema refusal, so the script's first step would fail and the kernel listing would go unverified; now `--action list`.
The script called `frob spark check --list` (802 under NJL-01's action rule), so the check that the archetype kernels appear in the library index would fail; now `--action list`.

The record was an unnamed 'architecture decision record' with the kill row 'marked first reading', which N40-03's loader refuses (no such marker; the ADR path must be the one its rule gives), so the entry would not load and BD-353's final entry, which cites `docs/adr/ADR-KILL-FDGRAD-M4.md`, would point at nothing; now names that ADR with N40-03's required fields, maps the rule's verdicts to `not-fired`, `fired` and `not-reached`, gives the M4 entry no `reading`, and states BD-353's `reading = "final"` entry; acceptance updated.

Enforcement said 704 fires only from the scheduler at dispatch and 761 at estimation, against convention 14 (704 from the size classifier at submission, before envelope admission; both before 701), and the e2e's admitted submission named no scope, so it would run as `adhoc` (E0) and be refused with 761 even with the record, leaving the admission untested; Enforcement restated and the submissions carry `--envelope-scope gate:GATE-PHYLUM-03/arm-A`.

Arm A and B jobs cited no envelope scope and arms C and D started from N17b-09's runners outside `frob-launch`, so every above-E0 job would be `adhoc` and refused with 761, and C and D would be unmetered and not evidence (N36-20); arm A/B jobs now carry `--envelope-scope gate:GATE-PHYLUM-03/arm-A|arm-B`, arms C/D run under `frob-launch --scope gate:GATE-PHYLUM-03/arm-C|arm-D --request R3`, the pilot-scale variant under `adhoc`.

The continuous 8,192-world background load (over an hour) and the per-edit sweeps named no scope, so the background job would be `adhoc` (E0) and refused with 761, and the incumbent rows on `trj` would be unmetered and not evidence; the background load and sweeps now cite `--envelope-scope gate:GATE-PHYLUM-04` (row R3's scope), the incumbent runs under `frob-launch --scope gate:GATE-PHYLUM-04 --request R3`.

The verb's input listed only key, budget and `sync_wait_ms` and its refusals omitted 704 and any order, so the implementer would build a schema without `envelope_scope` (no sweep could ever run above E0) and the e2e's expected 740 for a 1.87 TB population could come back as 761; the NJL-01 common inputs (with `--envelope-scope`), 704, and the order 740/741, then 704/761, then 701 (DESIGN) are stated, with unit test `sweep_refusal_order`.

`corpus_sealed_needs_key` expected exactly 1,024 entries, but the sealed reserve is appended to the sealed half and its encryption, so the test fails whenever a reserve exists; it now expects the 1,024 entries followed by the reserve of the size printed in the header.

The script ran `frob phylum plan` without the required `--worlds-per-design` (802) and gave no input selecting the planner's optimum; now `--worlds-per-design 16` with the default `--buckets registered` and again with `--buckets population`.

Steps 6 and 7 called `phylum.reuse --edit` without `--design` (802), and the recompute `sim.run` omitted the setup's `--task flat-stand`, so world addresses and environment would differ and every comparison fail; step 6 now uses N17-REF's pair `--design @fixture:quad-undigested --edit @fixture:edit-on-undigested-result` with N17-REF's exit 3, step 7 takes `--design quad-mod`, and the recompute carries `--task flat-stand`.

The recompute `frob sim run` omitted `--task flat-stand` while the compared sweep used it, so the episode digests would differ for a reason unrelated to reuse and the equivalence assertion would fail; added.

The incumbent harness ran outside any launcher, and N36-20 says an arm started any other way is not metered and is not evidence, so the pilot record (and KILL-PHYLUM read from it) would rest on unmetered runs; each repetition now runs under `frob-launch --scope adhoc` with E0 limits and the record cites the meter rows.

The pilot's command `frob sim run quad-ref …` set no ground, step or actions, so it ran the design's baseline controller on a default scene and step: never the reference step, never rough ground (which acceptance requires digests on) and never zero actions or a trace, and the falsifier would be read off the wrong workload; it now runs `--workload Q` and `Q:rough` (N36-33, which fixes design, ground, capacities and step) with `--policy zero` or `--controller open-loop:limbarm-trace`, a schedule the bead commits; dep N15ap3-01 added (no cycle).

Considerations record the gate `not attempted` when KILL-PHYLUM has fired, but the final reading allowed only `fired` or `not-fired`, so in that case the implementer had no true outcome to write in the ADR; `not-reached` added for that case, in Record and acceptance.

The text said `reread = ["M3"]` was 'requested of the kill ledger N40-29' (narration, convention 13), leaving the implementer unsure whether to add it; N40-29 carries it, now stated as a fact. Script step 2 ran `frob phylum plan` without the required `--worlds-per-design` (802), so the corpus coverage clause could not be measured; `--worlds-per-design 16` added.
